, in QCD at nonzero chemical potential, the pressure is a nonlinear function of the chemical potential.

the nonlinear susceptibilities are large and positive at small $\ensuremath{\nu},$ and the pressure at $\ensuremath{\mathrm{T}}=150\ensuremath{\mathrm{MeV}}$ and $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mu}}=500\ensuremath{\ensuremathtt{MeV}}\xspace$ is about $0.2\ensuremath{\sigma_{\mathrm{vac}}}\xspace$ above the vacuum energy density.
